title: Landing nag: node asks an agent for its landing line; long-running agents compact

chat.text: Seven of fourteen task masterminds today merged their work but ended without a landing line. Servex will now send such an agent one "land now" message with the exact line shape, wake the parent with the next brief when a child lands, and masterminds will compact past 150k tokens or 45 minutes while short-lived minions never do. Proven on a private Servex; the live one restarts when nothing is mid-tool.
